new operating income = 3,010,639.7 minus 1,817,388.7 = $1,193,251 thousand. operating margin = 1,193,251 / 3,010,639.7 = 0.3963, which is 39.6%.

## where to look
page 70 of the 2015 Annual Report. table "1.15.4 Cash flow analysis." data for FY2013 to FY2015 from continuing operations.

## operating cash flows
FY2015 net operating cash flows: 17,794 USD million. FY2014: 23,640 USD million.

## capex components
capex = property/plant/equipment purchase + exploration expenditure. FY2015: 11,947 + 816 = 12,763 USD million. FY2014: 15,224 + 986 = 16,210 USD million.

## free cash flow
FCF = operating cash flows minus capex. FY2015: 17,794 minus 12,763 = 5,031 USD million. FY2014: 23,640 minus 16,210 = 7,430 USD million.

## the change
5,031 minus 7,430 = -2,399 million USD.

## sales and net income data
document page 36 has "FIVE-YEAR SUMMARY OF SELECTED FINANCIAL DATA." values in millions except per share amounts. sales: 2016 = $7,766 million, 2017 = $7,782 million, 2018 = $7,939 million. net income: 2016 = $664 million, 2017 = $284 million, 2018 = $541 million.

## projected 2019 sales
average annual growth rate 2016 to 2018: calculated as (7,939 / 7,766)^(1/2) - 1 = 0.011117. 2019 sales = 7,939 × 1.011117 = $8,027.257863 million.

## graph on page 35
page 35 has the "Indexed Share Price Performance" graph. it tracks five-year total return for Foot Locker common stock vs. S&P 500 Index and S&P 500 Specialty Retailing Index. a data table below the graph has the specific values.

## foot locker values from the table
starting value at 2/1/2014: $100.00. value at 1/28/2017: $185.25. value at 2/3/2018: $135.37.

## specialty retailing values from the table
starting value at 2/1/2014: $100.00. value at 2/3/2018: $191.43. value at 2/2/2019: $198.35.

## foot locker value estimated at june 2017
june 2017 is about 5 months after 1/28/2017. the period from 1/28/2017 to 2/3/2018 is roughly 12 months. interpolation: $185.25 + (5/12) × ($135.37 − $185.25) = $185.25 + (5/12) × (−$49.88) = $185.25 − $20.78 = $164.47.

## specialty retailing value estimated at august 2018
august 2018 is about 6 months after 2/3/2018. period from 2/3/2018 to 2/2/2019 is roughly 12 months. interpolation: $191.43 + (6/12) × ($198.35 − $191.43) = $191.43 + 0.5 × $6.92 = $191.43 + $3.46 = $194.89.

## gains and difference
foot locker gain = $164.47 − $100.00 = $64.47. specialty retailing gain = $194.89 − $100.00 = $94.89. difference = $94.89 − $64.47 = $30.42.

## net sales numbers
values are in thousands of dollars. 2021 net sales = $159,000,000. 2020 net sales = $107,809,000. the change is (159,000,000 - 107,809,000) / 107,809,000 * 100 = 47.48 percent.

## reported 2021 operating profit
operating profit = $43,853 thousand.

## adjusted result
10.54% increase in operating expenses reduces operating profit. 43,853 times 0.8946 = 39,230.69 thousand.

## inventories as of january 31 2020
"CONSOLIDATED BALANCE SHEETS" on page 59. inventories = $44,238 (in thousands).

## cost of goods sold for year ended january 31 2020
"CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF INCOME." 2020 COGS = $69,912 (in thousands).

## ratio of inventories to cost of goods sold in 2020
69,912 / 44,238 = 1.5803607758.

## cost of goods sold for year ended january 31 2021
page 57 of "CONSOLIDATED STATEMENTS OF INCOME." 2021 COGS = $79,750 (in thousands).

## hypothetical inventories for january 31 2021
hypothetical inventories = 2021 COGS / 2020 ratio = 79,750 / 1.5803607758 = $50,463.1608307586 thousand.

## starting data from page 63
"INOTIV, INC. CONSOLIDATED BALANCE SHEETS (In thousands, except share amounts)." values as of fiscal year-end 2023. goodwill = $94,286 thousand. accumulated deficit = ($453,278 thousand). total equity = $268,490 thousand. cash and cash equivalents = $35,492 thousand. long-term debt (net of current portion) = $369,795 thousand.

## goodwill and accumulated deficit adjustments
goodwill impairment of $30,000 thousand reduces goodwill: 94,286 - 30,000 = $64,286 thousand. accumulated deficit grows by $20,000 thousand: deficit goes from ($453,278) to ($473,278 thousand).

## cash and long-term debt adjustments
cash: 35,492 × 1.20 = $42,590 thousand. long-term debt: 369,795 × 1.10 = $406,774.5 thousand. long-term debt changes do not affect equity directly.

## adjusted total equity
base equity = $268,490 thousand. goodwill impairment reduces equity by $30,000. accumulated deficit increase reduces equity by $20,000. new equity = 268,490 - 30,000 - 20,000 = $218,490 thousand.

page 51 of the Huntington 2024 Annual Report. chart: "Total Stockholder Returns." starting value of $100 for each index at december 31, 2019. chart shows HII using blue squares, S&P A&D Select using triangles, S&P 500 using circles.

## RSU activity table on page 119
document page 119. table: "The table below summarizes our RSU activity." units: in millions, except unit price. row "Balance, December 31, 2023," column "Number of RSUs" = 46 million RSUs outstanding.

## stock option activity table on page 119
document page 119. table: "The table below summarizes our stock option activity." units: in millions, except unit price. row "Outstanding at December 31, 2023," column "Number of Options" = 17 million. weighted average exercise price = $7.60.

## dilutive effect of stock options using treasury stock method at $10 share price
treasury stock method: (share price - exercise price) / share price × options outstanding. (10 - 7.60) / 10 × 17 million = 2.40 / 10 × 17 = 0.24 × 17 = 4.08 million. rounded to nearest million: 4 million dilutive shares.

## shares outstanding from balance sheet on page 103
Consolidated Balance Sheets on page 103. units in millions. Class A shares outstanding at December 31, 2023 = 1,616 million. Class B shares outstanding at December 31, 2023 = 175 million.

## fully diluted shares
1,616 (class A) + 175 (class B) + 4 (option dilution) + 46 (RSUs) = 1,841 million shares.

## 2024 data from page 100
"Consolidated Statements of Income" on page 100 of the 10-K. all amounts in millions. 2024: net interest income = $2,177.1 million. noninterest income = $6,113.3 million. noninterest expense = $5,633.9 million.

## projected 2025 values
net interest income up 5%: 2,177.1 × 1.05 = $2,285.955 million. noninterest income up 3%: 6,113.3 × 1.03 = $6,296.699 million. noninterest expense up 4%: 5,633.9 × 1.04 = $5,859.256 million.

## projected total revenue 2025
total revenue = net interest income + noninterest income = 2,285.955 + 6,296.699 = $8,582.654 million.

## projected operating income 2025
operating income = total revenue minus noninterest expense = 8,582.654 - 5,859.256 = $2,723.398 million. rounded to one decimal: $2,723.4 million.

## net income 2024 from page 100
Consolidated Statements of Income on page 100. units: in millions except share information. 2024 Net Income = $2,031.1 million.

## average total assets from page 169
"TABLE 121: DISTRIBUTION OF TOTAL ASSETS AND OPERATING PERFORMANCE" on page 169. units: $ in millions. 2024 Average Assets = $146,633.5 million.

## visa gain from notes
page 143, Note 18, "TABLE 87: OTHER OPERATING INCOME." footnote states other income for 2024 includes realized gains from sales of Visa Class C common shares. page 158 states the realized gain on Visa Class C shares was $870.4 million. page 44 confirms a $896.7 million gain related to an exchange offer for Visa shares. the Visa pre-tax gain for calculation purposes = $896.7 million.

## tax impact and adjusted net income
effective tax rate for 2024 = 23.6%. after-tax Visa gain = 896.7 × (1 - 0.236) = 896.7 × 0.764 = 685.0788 million. adjusted net income = 2,031.1 - 685.0788 = 1,346.0212 million.

## graph on page 18
page 18. graph title: "COMPARISON OF 5 YEAR CUMULATIVE TOTAL RETURN*." comparison is between Watsco, Inc., Russell 2000 Index, S&P Midcap 400 Index, and S&P 500 Index. y-axis: cumulative total return from $80 to $200 in $20 increments. x-axis: December 2014 through December 2019.

## watsco return at 12/18
starting value at 12/14 = $100. value at 12/18 = $145.63. (read from graph with axis reference.)

## S&P 500 return at 12/18
starting value at 12/14 = $100. value at 12/18 = $132.23.

## outperformance
45.63% minus 32.23% = 13.4 percentage points.

## chart location
10-K page 71. chart: "Five Year Cumulative Total Shareholder Return." four lines: Cigna, S&P 500, and two healthcare indexes.

## cigna numbers
Cigna at 12/31/2017 = $198. Cigna at 12/31/2019 = $199.

## S&P 500 numbers and change
S&P 500 at 12/31/2017 = $138. S&P 500 at 12/31/2019 = $174. (174 - 138) / 138 × 100 = 26.0869565217%. Cigna underperformed the S&P 500 during this period.

## data from page 74
table on page 74. adjusted revenues: 2018 = 48,111; 2019 = 140,175. Health Services segment revenues: 2018 = 6,606; 2019 = 96,447.

## total adjusted revenue increase
140,175 - 48,111 = 92,064 million.

## health services revenue increase
96,447 - 6,606 = 89,841 million.

## health services contribution percentage
89,841 / 92,064 × 100 = 97.5853764%. Health Services accounted for most of the total revenue increase from 2018 to 2019.

## cash flow data on page 82
page 82 of the 10-K. values in millions. Operating Activities: 2019 = $9,485 million; 2018 = $3,770 million. Investing Activities: 2019 = ($734 million); 2018 = ($26,378 million).

## combined cash flows for 2019
2019: 9,485 + (−734) = $8,751 million.

## combined cash flows for 2018
2018: 3,770 + (−26,378) = −$22,608 million.

## the change from 2018 to 2019
8,751 − (−22,608) = $31,359 million increase.

## balance sheet data on page 66
Consolidated Balance Sheets on page 66. units: in thousands, except share and per share amounts. December 31, 2021 values: total assets = $397,265 thousand. goodwill = $114,509 thousand. intangible assets = $40,963 thousand. total liabilities = $306,777 thousand.

## tangible assets and tangible book value
tangible assets = total assets - goodwill - intangibles = 397,265 - 114,509 - 40,963 = $241,793 thousand. tangible book value = tangible assets - total liabilities = 241,793 - 306,777 = negative $64,984 thousand.

## shares outstanding
Class B: 37,856,095 shares. Class A: 159,974,847 shares.

## TBVPS for each class
TBVPS for Class B = -64,984 / 37,856,095 = -$1.716606 per share. TBVPS per Class A diluted share = -64,984 / 159,974,847 = -$0.4062139 per share.

## total assets from page 50
Consolidated Balance Sheets on page 50. January 28, 2023. units: millions of dollars. total assets = $11,386 million.

## remove cash and cash equivalents
cash and cash equivalents in the Current assets section = $1,215 million. remove from operating assets.

## remove net deferred tax asset
deferred tax note on page 68 shows net deferred tax assets = $371 million. no marketable securities on the balance sheet. both cash and net deferred tax assets are non-operating items.

## operating assets
11,386 - 1,215 - 371 = $9,800 million.

## operating income from page 74
Consolidated Statements of Operations on page 74. "Income from operations" for 2021 = $143,395,000 (in thousands, so $143,395 thousand).

## effective tax rate
provision for income taxes = $5,659,000 (page 53). income before provision for income taxes = $51,960,000 (page 74). effective tax rate = 5,659,000 / 51,960,000 = 10.9%.

## projected operating income for next year
operating income grows at 12% CAGR. next year's operating income = 143,395,000 × (1 + 0.12) = $160,602,400.
